# Doxygen Awesome

These unmodified stylesheets come from [Doxygen Awesome v2.5.0](https://github.com/jothepro/doxygen-awesome-css/releases/tag/v2.5.0),
commit `46483f1e5a70ffb9ecd3b82d0a1cd1b24edf13da`.

The upstream MIT license is included in `LICENSE`. The files are stored here so
documentation builds do not need to fetch a theme from the network.

To update, replace both stylesheets and the license from the same upstream release,
then check the homepage, class navigation, and graphs in light and dark mode.
